notes: All browser/GPU jobs serialized; three same-machine 960x640 DPR1 reduced-motion 5s samples each side.
Default weather/traffic can differ with the new sampler and absolute time, so draw calls and CPU/heap differences are confounded; no claim of speedup or long-term leak freedom.
Desktop Chrome CPU4 and mobile-sized viewport are not physical phone evidence. JS heap excludes GPU/process memory.

knownLimitations: Programmatic birds and coastal weather are scenic approximations, not meteorology/ecological simulation.
Rain rings are analytic wave-surface effects, not collisions paired to each rain line.
Synthetic wind/rain/thunder rendered in native OfflineAudioContext; subjective speaker/headphone listening pending.
Physical phone, low-end sustained temperature/battery/process/GPU memory pending.
